description:
About Versapay 🚀
 
Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
 
By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually. 
 
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
 
 
 

Role Overview 

The Director, Channel Partnerships is a senior ecosystem leader responsible for defining and accelerating Versapay’s growth strategy across the Oracle ERP and technology partner community. This role owns the development of high-value relationships with NetSuite solution providers, systems integrators, advisory firms, SuiteApp and technology partners, industry associations, and key ecosystem influencers. The Director will translate executive relationships into repeatable go-to-market motions that generate qualified pipeline, bookings, customer value, and durable market presence. 

This leader will operate as both strategist and builder: setting the ecosystem vision, prioritizing the partners and segments where Versapay can win, creating joint business plans, and mobilizing sales, marketing, product, customer success, and operations around shared outcomes. The ideal candidate joins with an established network across ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology communities, plus a proven partner playbook that can be adapted quickly to Versapay’s business. This leader combines strong commercial judgment with the ability to lead through influence in a highly cross-functional environment. 

The role may be calibrated at Senior Manager or Director level based on the candidate’s network, scope of prior ownership, executive presence, and demonstrated ability to build repeatable, revenue-producing partner motions.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Ecosystem Strategy & Executive Leadership 

  • Own and evolve Versapay’s ERP ecosystem strategy, including partner segmentation, investment priorities, coverage, executive engagement, and multi-year growth plans. 

  • Serve as the senior external face of Versapay across the ERP and technology partner community, building trusted relationships with executives and practice leaders at priority solution providers, systems integrators, advisory firms, SuiteApp partners, and ecosystem organizations. 

  • Develop a clear point of view on market dynamics, partner economics, competitive positioning, customer needs, and emerging opportunities within the ERP customer and prospect base. 

  • Lead executive business reviews, joint planning sessions, and strategic workshops that translate partnership intent into measurable commitments, owners, timelines, and outcomes. 

  • Advise Versapay leadership on ecosystem opportunities, investment decisions, channel risks, and areas requiring product or commercial alignment. 

    • Partner Portfolio Growth & Activation 

  • Build and manage a focused portfolio of strategic ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology partners with differentiated engagement plans based on revenue potential, market influence, vertical expertise, geographic reach, and customer alignment. 

  • Bring, adapt, and operationalize a proven partner playbook spanning segmentation, recruitment, onboarding, enablement, co-sell, referrals, implementation influence, technology alliances, co-marketing, governance, and performance management.  

  • Establish joint account and territory plans with priority partners, identify whitespace, and coordinate partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities with sales leadership. 

  • Develop partner enablement strategies that equip partner sellers, consultants, and executives to position Versapay’s accounts receivable automation and payment capabilities with credibility. 

  • Leverage an existing industry network to identify, recruit, and launch new partners that fill strategic coverage gaps or unlock high-value customer segments. 

    • Go-to-Market & Revenue Execution 

  • Own the commercial performance of the ERP channel, with accountability for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, sales-qualified opportunities, bookings, activation, and partner productivity. 

  • Build joint value propositions and sales plays for priority industries, customer profiles, and use cases in collaboration with sales, product marketing, demand generation, and partner marketing. 

  • Lead account mapping, opportunity development, executive sponsorship, and deal acceleration motions with strategic partners. 

  • Partner with marketing to shape ecosystem campaigns, field programs, events, thought leadership, and community engagement that create measurable demand rather than activity alone. 

  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and performance reporting, surfacing insights, risks, decisions, and corrective actions to leadership. 

    • Cross-Functional Leadership & Customer Value 

  • Align product, integrations, sales, marketing, customer success, implementation, legal, finance, and operations around the needs of the ERP ecosystem and shared customers. 

  • Bring structured partner and market feedback into product roadmaps, integration priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer experience decisions. 

  • Create clear operating cadences, rules of engagement, escalation paths, and accountability across internal teams and partner organizations. 

  • Reduce channel friction by clarifying ownership, protecting partner trust, and ensuring opportunities are managed transparently and consistently. 

  • Champion a customer-first approach that connects partner strategy to implementation success, adoption, retention, and expansion. 

    • Market Presence & Thought Leadership 

  • Represent Versapay at ERP ecosystem conferences, partner summits, community events, executive forums, and customer conversations. 

  • Build Versapay’s reputation as a strategic accounts receivable and payments partner for the ERP and technology partner community through credible insights, strong relationships, and consistent execution. 

  • Develop a network of ecosystem advocates who can amplify Versapay’s value with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders. 

  • Contribute to external content, panels, webinars, partner stories, and other thought leadership that strengthens Versapay’s market position. 

    • Measures of Success

  • Growth in partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, sales-qualified opportunities, bookings, and revenue. 

  • Increased productivity and contribution from priority ERP, VAR, SI, ISV, advisory, and technology partners, including active sellers, qualified referrals, co-sell opportunities, and joint wins. 

  • Expansion of executive alignment and joint business planning across the highest-potential ecosystem relationships. 

  • Improved conversion, sales velocity, and customer outcomes for partner-involved opportunities. 

  • Consistent partner operating rigor, including account mapping, enablement, pipeline reviews, executive business reviews, and action follow-through. 

  • Stronger market presence and positive partner advocacy across the ERP ecosystem. 

    • Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, strategic alliances, ecosystem development, business development, or enterprise software, with meaningful leadership responsibility. 

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling partnerships within the Oracle ERP ecosystem, including relationships with solution providers, systems integrators, SuiteApp or technology partners, and ecosystem influencers. 

  • Established a portable network across ERP publishers, VARs, systems integrators, ISVs, advisory firms, accounting firms, and technology partners, with credibility among executives, practice leaders, sellers, consultants, and technical stakeholders. 

  • Proven ownership of partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue motions, including strategy, account mapping, joint planning, enablement, pipeline development, forecasting, and deal acceleration. 

  • Strong understanding of cloud ERP, accounts receivable automation, B2B payments, fintech, or adjacent enterprise software categories. 

  • Executive-level communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority. 

  • Commercial and analytical rigour, including experience defining KPIs, diagnosing performance gaps, and translating data into action. 

  • Ability to move fluidly between long-range strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 

    • Leadership Profile

  • Ecosystem-first: Builds trust, understands partner economics, and creates value for all parties. 

  • Strategic and commercial: Connects market insight and relationships to measurable business growth. 

  • Builder mindset: Creates structure, playbooks, and repeatable motions where none exist. 

  • Executive presence: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and credibility across senior audiences. 

  • High ownership: Sets a high bar, follows through, and addresses obstacles directly. 

  • Collaborative: Mobilizes cross-functional teams while preserving accountability and speed. 

  • Customer-centered: Keeps shared customer value at the center of partnership decisions. 

    • Company Culture & Strategic Impact

    Versapay is a collaborative, growth-oriented organization focused on transforming accounts receivable and B2B payments. This role will have meaningful influence over how the company scales through the ERP ecosystem, expands its market reach, and creates differentiated value for NetSuite customers and partners. The Director will help shape not only the ERP channel strategy, but also the operating model, market narrative, and cross-functional commitment required to turn ecosystem advantage into sustainable growth.

    Why Join Us?

  • Lead a visible, strategic growth engine within one of the most influential cloud ERP ecosystems. 

  • Shape Versapay’s ERP channel strategy and build the executive relationships, programs, and operating model needed to scale it. 

  • Connect partnership strategy directly to revenue growth, customer outcomes, and product evolution. 

  • Work across a high-impact team that values relationships, accountability, innovation, and measurable results. 

    • We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
